# discovery

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

Discovery scope, publication, fixed route and immutable composition values; persistent collection ownership is in discovery_state.

`connectors.discovery` is one of connectors's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `CollectionCoverage`

`connectors.discovery.CollectionCoverage` is a record of two fields:

- `complete` — `Boolean`
- `partitions` — `List<connectors.discovery.PartitionCoverage>`

### `CollectionScope`

`connectors.discovery.CollectionScope` is a record of six fields:

- `instance` — `String`
- `source_connection` — `String`
- `declaration` — `String`
- `profile` — `String`
- `scope_ref` — `String`
- `selection_revision` — `String`

### `CompositionDeclaration`

`connectors.discovery.CompositionDeclaration` is a record of four fields:

- `declaration_revision` — `String`
- `instances` — `List<connectors.discovery.CompositionInstance>`
- `route_bindings` — `List<connectors.discovery.InstalledRouteBinding>`
- `limits` — `connectors.discovery.CompositionLimits`

### `CompositionFacts`

`connectors.discovery.CompositionFacts` is a record of six fields:

- `profiles_compatible` — `Boolean`
- `parent_is_direct` — `Boolean`

### `CompositionInstance`

`connectors.discovery.CompositionInstance` is a record of four fields:

- `configuration_revision` — `String`

### `CompositionLimits`

`connectors.discovery.CompositionLimits` is a record of four fields:

- `max_scopes` — `Integer`
- `max_rows_per_scope` — `Integer`
- `max_concurrent_provider_requests` — `Integer`
- `max_provider_response_bytes` — `Integer`

Every value satisfies `(max_scopes >= 1 and max_scopes <= 256)`, `(max_rows_per_scope >= 1 and max_rows_per_scope <= 500)`, `(max_concurrent_provider_requests >= 1 and max_concurrent_provider_requests <= 4)` and `max_provider_response_bytes >= 1`.

`connectors.discovery.SnapshotSummary` is a record of four fields:
